﻿# 他的GEO工具一年做到5位数月入

## 冷启动：1995年就上线，28年的 builder

Daniel always been bit of internet nerd and builder。

Background in business and growth。

Started career very early。

First got online in 1995 and built first website shortly after。

Not long after that，already designing and developing websites for clients。

Over years，built、scaled、sold websites、mobile apps、Chrome extensions。

In 2007，turned one of own projects into real business。

In 2013，started one of first ASO (App Store Optimization) agencies globally。

Now employs team of 15 people。

In 2017，launched ASO SaaS product。

Didn't become originally expected，but ended up selling in 2021。

Then，May 2025，saw brands appear (or not) in AI-generated answers。

Clear this would matter。

Wanted to prove to self could build SaaS and turn into truly large business。

So decided to move fast。

Found two people really wanted to build with。

Started LLM Pulse。

Launched in July 2025 with two cofounders — Adrián Rojas and Esteve Castells。

Help brands monitor and improve how show up in AI-driven search platforms like ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity。

Fully bootstrapped。

Team just three cofounders。

Forces stay extremely focused on what drives growth or product value。

No roadmap for sake of it。

Currently at mid-five-figure MRR。

Growing steadily month over month，with growth accelerating over time。

## 反直觉：2个月就上线，边做边学

With previous SaaS project，spent too much time and money building first version。

Didn't want to repeat。

Started building MVP of LLM Pulse in May 2025 and launched in July。

Goal wasn't build perfect product。

Quickly validate could reliably measure how brands show up in AI-generated answers。

Focused only on core：building something worked，gave reliable data，people willing to pay for。

Once worked，layered everything else on top。

Kept stack simple and pragmatic。

Avoided typical big cloud setups。

Run most infrastructure on dedicated servers instead。

Gives more control and keeps costs predictable as scale。

## 暴击：没有 playbook，反而成了优势

Biggest challenge building in space with no clear playbooks。

Things change fast。

Constantly making decisions with incomplete information。

Had to be creative and make decisions from first principles。

Testing things quickly and iterating based on what worked。

Also been very reactive。

Don't try to solve problems before exist。

Deal with them when show up。

Advice for those in similar position：

Keep it simple，move fast，continuously adjust as learn。

##  punchline：失败和犯错是游戏的一部分

His advice：

Forget about perfection。

Build fast，ship often，don't waste time worrying about problems don't exist yet。

Most things afraid of won't happen。

Ones that do，figure them out。

You will fail and make mistakes。

That's part of game。

Just keep going。

Going forward，plan simple：

Build great product，give great support，have lot of happy customers。

Beyond that：

Keep team small。

Move fast。

Double down on what's already working。

Aiming to build something big。

Important part of motivation this time。

Keep going。

Keep building，keep improving，see how far can take it。

And have fun。
